notes.title: Chapter 9 and Chapter 10 updated
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Divers,[/h2][h2]We’ve been listening closely to your feedback, and we know a lot of you had frustrations with certain chapters. Today’s update is all about making your experience smoother, more engaging, and less repetitive. Here’s what’s changing:[/h2][p][/p][p][/p][p]           [b]Chapter 9 – Streamlined Exploration[/b][/p][p][b]            Goal:[/b] Reduce unnecessary back-and-forth.[/p][list][*][p] [b]Battery Requirement Reduced[/b] – You’ll now only need to place [b]2 batteries instead of 4[/b] to progress.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]More Creature Encounters[/b] – Added additional creatures to keep the tension high.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]New Submarine Mechanic[/b] – In 2-Player Mode, the player in the sub can now [b]fire missiles to blast through rock walls[/b], opening up new paths.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p] [b]UI & Control Updates[/b] – The submarine HUD and controls have been reworked for clarity and smoother gameplay.


[b]Chapter 10 – Quality of Life Upgrade[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]           Goal:[/b] Improve overall flow and reduce frustration.[/p][list][*][p][b]Less Falling Debris[/b] – Rock and debris drops have been reduced by [b]40%[/b], giving you more breathing room.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Missile Mechanic Added[/b] – Just like Chapter 9, the submarine can now [b]blast rock walls[/b] to help you push forward.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]UI & Control Updates[/b] – Same submarine updates carried over for consistency.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]We Hear You[/h3][p]Your feedback continues to shape the game. These changes are just the start—keep sharing your thoughts with us, and we’ll keep improving Deepest Trench together.[/p][p][/p][p]Dive safe,
[b]The Deepest Trench Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update #3
notes.content:
[u][h1][b]User Interface Fixes [/b][/h1][/u]

[list]
[*] Changed the "Follow" to "Call" on the UI to better reflect it's feature. 
[*] Moved the Steam overlay to the co-op 2 player selection screen.
[/list]

 

[u][h1][b]Gameplay Fixes [/b][/h1][/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed audio bug with the sub grabbing batteries.
[*] Added voiceover skip.
[*] Removed the ability to drop tools.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Build Update #2
notes.content:
[u][h1][b]User Interface Fixes [/b][/h1][/u]

[list]
[*] Increased the amount of time captions remain on the screen. 
[*] Added an initial caption to rremind players to examine the mini map.
[*] Mini map icons are removed when objective is completed. 
[*] Added a new task on Chapter 3 to help guide players.
[*] Updated a task on Chapter 3 to help guide players.
[/list]

 

[u][h1][b]Gameplay Fixes [/b][/h1][/u]

[list]
[*] Added voice Lines to assist players with shark encounters.
[*] Added some extra lights on Chapter 3.
[*] Fixed Textures on Chapter 2.
[*] Increased the brightness on battery inserts.
[*] Increased the brightness on the fuse.
[*] Adjusted the access card.
[*] Fixed a bug in Chapter 1 where sprinting would cut the captions short.
[*] Fixed a sun spot.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Bug Fixes for October 3, 2024
notes.content:
[u][h1][b]User Interface Fixes [/b][/h1][/u]

[list]
[*] Increased “out of bounds” timer to give players more time to turn around. 
[*] Reduced tutorial text to better explain controls for character swaps. 
[*] Added an initial caption to remind players to consistently monitor oxygen levels.
[*] Added a tip to inform players on how to see current objectives.
[*] Added a tip to teach players about tools.
[*] Completed objectives now disappear off the mini-map.
[*] Task drawer time increased.
[*] Fixed “ascend” and “descend” controls layout for the submersible.
[/list]

 

[u][h1][b]Gameplay Fixes [/b][/h1][/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed death animations when dying “out of bounds”.
[*] Fixed collider issue with a fuse and the wall. 
[*] Fixed pathing on the shark to give extra time. 
[*] Fixed collision/clip-through issue with the wall in Chapter 3.
[*] Heartbeat radius increased for megalodon when outside the facility. 
[/list]

 

[u][h1][b]Hardware Fixes [/b][/h1][/u]

[list]
[*] For controllers, fixed a never-ending vibration after stage completion. 
[/list]
